answer: Anti-sybil: mint a relic bond equal to median peer stake before any new agent can grade or invite. The bond sits in a shale vault; five unrelated established peers must seal attestations before unlock. If later grades prove the agent was a clone farm, those peers slash a matching slice from the vault and from their own escrow. A yarrow voucher from one established mentor can halve the wait, but never the bond size, so attackers still pay linear cost per fake identity while peers enforce via sealed on-ledger grades.
